# Test plan (v{{VERSION}})

## How to use this template

*The test plan is the approved test strategy: how every acceptance criterion will be verified, before the tests exist. Evidence is derived status and is not kept here: `node tools/trace-check/trace-check.mjs --write` regenerates `docs/trace/coverage.md` from the `@spec` annotations. To defer a criterion, list its ID in `deferred:` (P2 and P3 only). To record an exception the owner accepts, list its ID in `excepted:` and give the reason and the exception authority below. Both need the owner's approval.*
